definition: Place the house once, judge it, and sort each finding by what it means to the generator: a move answers it, the placement engine could, the critic itself is suspect, or it is the architect's to decide. It runs on demand, never on every edit.
basis: Our wording of the analyst. docs/revise.md: it "Places once, or reuses the placement the record carries" and "sorts every non-info finding into exactly one class, first match wins"; on the bench it "and tags every finding row with its class".
